page.overview:
Who is Apple Split?

Apple Split, or Apple Bottoms, is a background Earth pony and a member of the Apple family. He has a blue coat, a red mane, reddish brown eyes, and a cutie mark of three bottom halves of apples. He is not named in the show, but he is named "Apple Split" with a trademark symbol in first-party merchandise and named "Apple Bottoms" in second-party other media.__TOC__

Apple Split shares his design, eye color, and accessory with S04E22 Unnamed Earth Stallion #12.

In Pinkie Apple Pie, Apple Split appears in a photo on a wall in Goldie Delicious' cabin. In Trade Ya!, he briefly appears at the Rainbow Falls Traders Exchange.

In The Gift of the Maud Pie, Apple Split is seen walking on the sidewalk of Manehattan at sunset.
